title: Skill leak gate and split lock v1
description: Whether a candidate skill carries the expected answers or checks of any eval item (dev, val or test), n-gram by n-gram outside an allowlist, and whether the dev/val/test split is the one locked at first use: no split change, and no test item given to the proposer. Written by `eval leak`; status is blocked when a violation is found, and inconclusive when an item could not be checked or none could.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

lock_path.description: The split lock file; null without --split.

ngram.description: Words in a run; an item shorter than this after the allowlist is unchecked.

min_fraction.description: An item is flagged when this share of its runs is in the skill.

skill_files.description: The text files of the skill that were read, relative to the skill directory.

split.description: The split assignment and its lock; null without --split.

state.description: created: the lock was written at this run; matched: the lock has this digest; changed: the lock has another digest and was not rewritten.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the sorted id -> split pairs.

moved.description: Question ids whose split differs from the lock (state changed only).

exposed_test_items.description: Test question ids in the proposer's list.

grams.description: Distinct runs of the item's expected answers and checks, outside the allowlist.

shared.description: Those runs that occur in the skill.

reason.description: Why the item is unchecked; null otherwise.

files.description: Skill files that hold a shared run.
